name: Zona thần kinh

A stylized torso / ribcage side profile showing a gentle curved cluster of small soft pink vesicles/rash along a dermatome line. Elegant flowing wavy paper cutout layers in pastel lavender, warm ivory cream, and soft blush, with minimalist botanical leaves and flora.

name: Nấm da (hắc lào)

Pale lavender and warm white curved wavy paper relief, violet #7450b8 accents and soft muted coral, framed by botanical leaves.
